concept: qmd unit and layout of vector storage
current_formulation: qmd embeds chunks of about 900 tokens into a sqlite-vec vec0 table partitioned by collection, and qmd cleanup repacks the table when deletes leave holes.

steps.formulation: The first commit stores one vector per document, keyed by content hash, in the vec0 table vectors_vec.

criticism.quote: averages everything together, matching poorly for specific queries

steps.formulation: Release 0.3.0 (code commit of 2025-12-08) embeds chunks of about 900 tokens instead of whole documents.
steps.quote: Chunking produces one embedding per ~900-token section with focused semantic signal.

criticism.quote: small collections crowded out of the global ANN candidate pool

steps.formulation: Release 2.9.0 (layout commit of 2026-09-24) partitions the vector table by collection, so a scoped query scans only its collection.
steps.quote: The vector index is partitioned by collection.

criticism.quote: re-embeds and orphan removal leave holes in older chunks that every brute-force scan still reads

steps.formulation: qmd cleanup repacks the vector table when it has holes.
steps.quote: repack the vector table when it has holes
